content: Nykaa offers a 15-day return window for Apparel and Footwear products. Beauty products can only be returned within 5 days of delivery if unopened. Home and Electronics items are subject to a 7-day replacement guarantee.

Cash on Delivery (COD) refunds are processed via bank transfer within 5-7 business days after the item passes quality check. Customers must provide verified UPI or bank account details in their profile.
Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days for metro cities and 5 to 7 business days for non-metro regions. Express delivery guarantees dispatch within 24 hours for eligible postal codes.
Reverse pickup is available for standard locations across India free of charge. If reverse pickup service is unavailable at your pin code, self-courier reimbursements up to INR 100 are provided.
Electronics sold on Nykaa come with standard 1-year manufacturer warranty from the date of billing. Apparel and Beauty products do not carry extended warranty terms beyond standard return periods.
Orders can be canceled anytime before they transition to the Shipped status. Once shipped, cancellations cannot be accepted directly, and items must be rejected upon delivery.
Nykaa reward points can be redeemed during checkout at a value of 1 point equal to 1 INR. Points expire after 12 months from the date of credit and cannot be combined with selected promo codes.
If a payment fails, debited funds are auto-refunded to the source account within 3 to 5 working days. Customers can retry failed transactions immediately from the order history tab.
Size exchanges for Apparel and Footwear are free of charge subject to stock availability. Request size exchange within 7 days of delivery through the orders section.
For damaged or defective items, intimate customer care within 48 hours of delivery with unboxing images. Replacements or full refunds will be initiated following verification.
International shipping is limited to select countries and excludes liquid cosmetics and aerosol products. Import duties and taxes are payable by the customer at the destination.
Standard queries are resolved by Level 1 AI support within minutes. Unresolved issues escalate to human agents at Level 2, while critical disputes reach senior managers within 24 hours.
